notes: Omen on small screens: every experience now has a compact layout for screens with a short side of 480 or less (3.5" and 5" USB screens, AIO pump heads). It shows by priority: the time, date and weather first, then each part's lead reading…
A dense design also switches to the compact layout on any screen where its own text would fall under 8 pixels.
Fixed: Console, Core and Optic took their wide-strip layout on any screen under 600 tall (such as 480×360).
Fixed on portrait monitors (1080×1920, 720×1280, 800×1280): Helm, Thebe, Ember, Horizon, Arche and IO were sized for narrow bars, so rings overlapped and the time ran off the top.

Fixed with extreme readings: Helm's three-digit temperature hit its degree mark; Europa, Circuit, Ember, IO and Hollow text collided on some sizes. Every experience is now checked at 35 sizes with typical and worst-case readings.
